title: Workshop reservation
purpose: Document the requested workshop reservation behavior and list undecided decisions for human resolution.

scope.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

requirements.text: Let visitors reserve a place in a workshop.

stories.text: As a visitor, I want to reserve a place in a workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visitor has chosen a workshop, when the visitor completes the reservation action, then the system records a reservation for that visitor and that workshop.

edge_cases.text: When a reservation is attempted before payment, account, capacity, cancellation, owner, or release-date decisions are made, the system should not assume any of those policies.

dependencies.text: Payment, account, capacity limit, cancellation, owner, and release date are not decided.

risks.text: Building the reservation flow before those decisions are made may require rework when a human selects the policies.

success_metrics.text: A tester can observe that completing a workshop reservation results in a recorded reservation.

open_questions: Is payment required for a visitor to reserve a place in a workshop?
Is a user account required for a visitor to reserve a place in a workshop?
Is there a capacity limit on workshop reservations?
Can a visitor cancel a reservation after making it?
Who is the owner of the workshop reservation feature?
When will the workshop reservation feature be released?
